integrity: The fresh nonprojective-M source and the earlier meromorphic-convexity source were inspected directly at their definitions and curve/Picard-relevant statements. The new theorem was reconstructed from one-variable function-field theory and an explicit divisor-restriction argument. No numerical experiment or external certification is used.
scientific_limitations: The extension theorem is stated for smooth connected compact curves and gives meromorphic, not holomorphic, extension. The Picard positivity condition is necessary, not sufficient, for the M-property. A classical formulation under older meromorphic-separability terminology may encode the same restriction-field lemma; no such covering theorem was found in the bounded literature search.
title: Curve-extension rigidity and Picard detectability in compact M-manifolds
